prompt: Create a high-resolution 2048x2048 four-view reference sheet for one D&D Quasit demon tabletop miniature. Same full-body creature and alert crouching combat-ready pose in every panel. A tiny lean green demon with short curved horns, pointed ears, clawed hands and feet, a long curled tail and a mischievous snarling face. Unarmed, no clothing, no wings. Simple clean design and distinct silhouette. Painted realistic miniature style. White background, no base, no text or labels. Four equal square panels: top left FRONT, top right BACK, bottom left LEFT SIDE, bottom right RIGHT SIDE. Orthographic views, complete creature with margins, same scale and pose across all four views.
